name: tier-router
description: Picks Haiku, Sonnet, Opus or Fable for each prompt with a decision model: tev1 or laya locally in Ollama (on CPU or GPU), or Jev in TypeSafe's cloud. Pick which models it may choose. No proxy, no Claude tokens spent on routing.

backend.title: Decision backend
backend.description: ollama: a local decision model (tev1 or laya, see Decision model). jev: TypeSafe's cloud Jev (needs an API key).

ollamaUrl.title: Ollama URL
ollamaUrl.description: Where Ollama serves the decision model.

tev1Model.title: Decision model
tev1Model.description: The local decision model to ask. tev1: 4.4 GB, the best tested, English and Hebrew. tev1:0.8b: less memory. laya: English-only, 0.8 GB and fastest (needs Ollama 0.40); Hebrew prompts route much worse. The plugin offers to download it, and to upgrade Ollama when the model needs a newer one.

device.title: Run the decision model on
device.description: auto: wherever your Ollama puts it (a GPU when it has one). cpu: a CPU-only Ollama the plugin starts on port 11435, leaving the GPU to your other work. gpu: your Ollama, and /router says when the model ended up on the CPU anyway.

jevApiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
jevApiKey.description: Only for the jev backend. Sent to the Jev URL as a bearer token.

jevModel.title: Jev model
jevModel.description: The Jev model id to ask.

fableModel.title: Fable model
fableModel.description: Model id for the hardest, longest tasks: above Opus.

useHaiku.title: Use Haiku
useHaiku.description: Let the router pick Haiku for quick tasks. A task for a model that is off goes to the nearest one above it that is on, else the nearest below. `/router models` sets all four at once.

useSonnet.title: Use Sonnet
useSonnet.description: Let the router pick Sonnet for normal tasks. A task for a model that is off goes to the nearest one above it that is on, else the nearest below. `/router models` sets all four at once.

useOpus.title: Use Opus
useOpus.description: Let the router pick Opus for hard tasks. A task for a model that is off goes to the nearest one above it that is on, else the nearest below. `/router models` sets all four at once.

useFable.title: Use Fable
useFable.description: Let the router pick Fable, the high end above Opus, for the hardest tasks. Off by default: it costs the most. A task for a model that is off goes to the nearest one above it that is on, else the nearest below. `/router models` sets all four at once.
